color.evidence: Paper/mist/deep bands. Audit 0/111 contrast fails. Four RK-blue app tints. Square navy CTAs. Wordmark uses --brand #2f256c.
strengths: App tiles stay RK navy tints, not competitor purple

issues.problem: Leather tile fill is raw #e8eef6, outside the named set.
issues.fix: Replace #e8eef6 with color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue) 8%, var(--mist)).

spacing_rhythm.evidence: Audit 99.1% 4px grid. .pack section padding is s5 (24px). Prior overlapping bars, 11rem min-height, and stagger margin-top are gone. .flow is 2x2 with align-items:start; card 03 shorter than 04.
strengths: 99.1% spacing grid adherence on a 4px scale
s5 pack padding without 11rem empty card holes
Process left/right 4px bars do not overlap

issues.problem: align-items:start leaves 03 shorter than 04; row bottoms and the 4px end bars do not line up.
issues.fix: Set .flow { align-items: stretch; } and do not add min-height.

issues.problem: Content tiles use 4px radius. DESIGN limits 4px to photographs.
issues.fix: Set border-radius: 0 on .apps article and .flow li.

issues.problem: Schematic is max-width 22rem, leaving a paper hole beside it.
